Birds feed on vessel fish guts and heads. No annual processing-offal mass or quantified additional supply to group35 is identified in the inspected source.

original_balance_availability.interpretation: The native database itself stores negative Export for Discards while native BiomAcc, BiomAccRate and DtImports are zero. This is saved source evidence, not proof of a freshly reproduced native EwE balance or of author intent; input/output status of this saved field requires native-engine inspection.
